administration.note: Reform UK is the largest party (20 of 58, down from 23 at the May 2025 election after defections, mostly to Restore Britain) and runs a MINORITY administration. Leader Cllr George Finch (Reform) survived a no-confidence vote 27-26 on 17 March 2026 and the 14 May 2026 AGM; the all-Reform 2026/27 Cabinet was announced 22 May 2026. The Conservatives (9) act as informal kingmakers. Composition: Reform 20, Liberal Democrat 14, Conservative 9, Green 6, Labour 3, Independent 4, Restore Britain 2. Leader of the Opposition: Cllr Sarah Boad (Liberal Democrat, 14).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no Exceptional Financial Support, no Best Value Notice). DSG / SEND deficit forecast GBP 327m by March 2028; High Needs Stability Grant funds 90% to end 2025/26; SEND fully Government-funded from 2028/29.
mtfs._source: Warwickshire CC 2026/27 Revenue Budget Resolution (democracy.warwickshire.gov.uk doc s47591 + api.warwickshire.gov.uk), full Council 17 Feb 2026, passed by 6 votes.

political_arithmetic.note: Reform UK runs a minority administration (20 of 58, 30 needed) and depends on Conservative non-opposition to survive votes; it won the March 2026 no-confidence vote 27-26. Largest opposition group: Liberal Democrat (14, Cllr Sarah Boad).
